messages:
sasha: Dropping a new vendor model bundle (zeta-3.0) into intake. Need provenance checklist + registry path. I have weights, tokenizer, and supplier manifest. s3 path: s3://ml-ingest/incoming/zeta-3.0/ (private).
mina: Thanks — quick flow: 1) checksum each file 2) verify signatures 3) record hashes in ledger 4) move to /registry after quarantine. Do you have a signed manifest?
ajay: If tokenizer changed we need vocab diff + small tokenization smoke tests. I can run the tokenization drift eval once files are final.
ingest-bot: ingest-bot: New upload detected at s3://ml-ingest/incoming/zeta-3.0/ by sasha. Files: weights.pt (1.2G), tokenizer.zip (5.4M), manifest.json (4KB), sigs/ (3 files). Status: quarantine.
mina: Pasting checklist snippet for handoff (use exactly these commands):
```
# compute checksums
sha256sum weights.pt > weights.pt.sha256
sha256sum tokenizer.zip > tokenizer.zip.sha256
sha256sum manifest.json > manifest.json.sha256

# verify GPG signatures (partner provided):
gpg --keyring ./partner-keys.gpg --verify sigs/manifest.json.sig manifest.json

# verify KMS envelope if used (example):
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://sigs/weights.pt.kms.cipher --output text --query Plaintext | base64 --decode > weights.pt

# create artifact ledger entry (manual/cli):
# fields: model, version, source, weights_sha256, tokenizer_sha256, signed_by, proof_url
```

sasha: Running checksums now: `sha256sum weights.pt > weights.pt.sha256 && sha256sum tokenizer.zip > tokenizer.zip.sha256`. Will upload sigs after GPG verify.
lia: Registry notes: API requires `signed_by` and `proof_url`. Use POST /api/v1/artifacts with X-API-KEY header. Tag new record as `unverified` until smoke eval passes. Set S3 storage-class=INTELLIGENT_TIERING for the registry bucket.
ajay: For quantization experiments we need FP16 and INT8 candidates. Add a model-card with eval prompts + baseline metrics and store under /models/zeta-3.0/evals/ so Optimize can pick it up.
sasha: Done checksums and GPG verify. Found one tokenizer mismatch — partner re-uploaded corrected tokenizer.zip. Re-run checksums, all green. Uploading to registry path and creating record now.
ingest-bot: ingest-bot: Artifact registered: /registry/models/zeta-3.0/weights.pt (sha256: abc123def456...), manifest -> /registry/models/zeta-3.0/manifest.json. Status: registered:pending-eval.
mina: I'll kick off the smoke eval and a baseline quantization pass. @ajay please pick the int8 recipe (static calibration preferred). ETA ~2h.
ajay: On it — I'll run static calibration with 512-token calibrator and output quant artifacts to /registry/models/zeta-3.0/quant/ for review. Will also produce a small eval report (perplexity + decode stability).
sasha: :thumbsup: Leaving partner transfer ticket #8342 and signed-by gpg:0xA1B2C3 in the registry notes. Thanks everyone.
